thesis: Platform growth is established while credit-adjusted per-share returns are not. Neither side supplies the banking evidence required for a directional valuation judgment.
strongest_counterexample: Adjusted revenue rose 40%, guidance increased and net income is positive, marking meaningful scaling progress.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of rising net charge-off rate and falling diluted EPS.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of diluted EPS growth with non-increasing net charge-off rate.
evidence_gaps: Capital ratios, loan vintages, net charge-offs and diluted EPS bridge.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Revenue and member growth provide evidence of platform expansion
Scaling into positive profits is meaningful, but adjusted revenue and user growth must translate into credit-quality-adjusted per-share returns
